top_signals.title: Korea Eximbank to Lend $1 Billion to Glencore for Copper Supply
top_signals.summary: Export-Import Bank of Korea will lend $1 billion to commodities giant Glencore Plc in exchange for copper supply to South Korean companies, as the country seeks to secure raw materials needed for the artificial intelligence boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
